body:
Remove any reference to react-themeable, theme={} props. Load the
Algolia theme when relevant.

![2016-12-01-152218_1116x744_scrot](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/20797182/fba294ee-b7d9-11e6-9e51-705964a43992.png)

BREAKING CHANGE:
- CSS is no more injected by default, read our styling guide to know how
to load it
- react-themeable, theme={} prop have been removed from the codebase,
the only way to style widgets is now to use CSS class names
title: feat(theme): move to CSS file and CSS class names only theming
